statements.select:
SELECT 'S' AS MODE ,DEPT.COMPANY_CD ,COM.COMP_NM AS COMPANY_NM ,DEPT.DEPT_CD ,DEPT.DEPT_CD AS PREID ,DEPT.DEPT_NM ,DEPT.DEPT_ENG_NM ,DEPT.DEPT_LEVEL ,DEPT.UP_DEPT_CD ,DEPT.DEPT_MGR ,USR.USER_NM AS DEPT_MGR_NM ,DEPT_SDATE ,DEPT_EDATE ,DEPT.CCTR ,DEPT.PRCTR ,ISNULL(DEPT.SADEPT_YN,'N') AS SADEPT_YN ,ISNULL(DEPT.USE_YN,'N') AS USE_YN ,DEPT.REG_DT ,DEPT.REG_USR ,DEPT.MOD_DT ,DEPT.MOD_USR ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE UP_DEPT_CD = DEPT.DEPT_CD) AS CHILD_CNT FROM T_DEPARTMENT DEPT LEFT JOIN T_USER USR ON DEPT.DEPT_MGR = USR.USER_CD LEFT JOIN T_COMPANY COM ON DEPT.COMPANY_CD = COM.COMPANY_CD WHERE 1=1
AND DEPT.DEPT_CD LIKE '%' + #searchDeptId# + '%'
AND DEPT.DEPT_NM LIKE '%' + #searchDeptNm# + '%'
AND DEPT.DEPT_LEVEL = #searchLevel#
AND DEPT.UP_DEPT_CD = #updeptId#
AND DEPT.DEPT_CD = #deptId#
AND DEPT.DEPT_CD != #preDeptId#
AND DEPT.USE_YN = #searchUseYn#
AND DEPT.SADEPT_YN = #sadeptYn#
ORDER BY DEPT.DEPT_CD ASC
statements.insert: INSERT INTO T_DEPARTMENT ( COMPANY_CD , DEPT_CD , DEPT_NM , DEPT_ENG_NM , DEPT_LEVEL , UP_DEPT_CD , DEPT_MGR , DEPT_SDATE , DEPT_EDATE , CCTR , PRCTR , SADEPT_YN , USE_YN , REG_DT , REG_USR , MOD_DT , MOD_USR ) VALUES ( #companyCd# , #deptId# , #deptName# , #engName# , #level# , #upDeptCd# , #mgrCd# , #startDate# , #endDate# , #cctr# , #prctr# , #sadeptYn# , #useYn# , GETDATE() , #userCd# , GETDATE() , #userCd# )
statements.update: UPDATE T_DEPARTMENT SET DEPT_CD = #deptId# ,DEPT_NM = #deptName# ,DEPT_ENG_NM = #engName# ,DEPT_LEVEL = #level# ,UP_DEPT_CD = #upDeptCd# ,DEPT_MGR = #mgrCd# ,DEPT_SDATE = #startDate# ,DEPT_EDATE = #endDate# ,CCTR = #cctr# ,PRCTR = #prctr# ,SADEPT_YN = #sadeptYn# ,USE_YN = #useYn# ,MOD_DT = GETDATE() ,MOD_USR = #userCd# WHERE COMPANY_CD = #companyCd# AND DEPT_CD = #preId#
statements.delete: DELETE FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE COMPANY_CD = #companyCd# AND DEPT_CD = #deptCd#
statements.select:
SELECT USR.COMPANY_CD, USR.USER_CD AS USER_CD , USR.USER_NM AS USER_NM , DEP.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM , USR.USER_TITLE AS USER_TITLE , USR.USER_POSIT AS USER_POSIT , USR.EMAIL AS EMAIL , USR.REG_DT , USR.REG_USR , USR.MOD_DT , USR.MOD_USR FROM T_USER USR ,T_DEPARTMENT DEP WHERE 1=1 AND USR.DEPT_CD = DEP.DEPT_CD
AND USR.USER_NM LIKE '%' + #searchUserNm# + '%'
AND USR.DEPT_CD = #selPart3#
AND (DEP.UP_DEPT_CD = #selPart2# OR USR.DEPT_CD = #selPart2#)
AND (DEP.UP_DEPT_CD in (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPT_CD = #selPart1#) OR USR.DEPT_CD = #selPart1#)
AND USR.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
ORDER BY USER_NM
